"Due to a newly added feature on the latest versions of Android, Athan notification may not fire on time when the phone is on sleep mode (screen off). We have added a new feature called 'Athan Alarm Mode' that will make sure to fire the Athan with no delay. However, using this mode necessitates showing an alarm icon (⏰) on your notification bar. If this icon bothers you, you can switch to the standard mode anytime following: <b>Preferences > Athan and Reminders > Athan Alarm Mode<b/>"
